title: Algorithm Modelization: Transforming Optimization Algorithms into Evolvable Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.23161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can algorithms be learned and evolved as models, rather than repeatedly redesigned as programs? We explore this question by introducing Algorithm Modelization, a new paradigm that turns iterative algorithms into trainable models. Its central idea is to regard algorithm execution trajectories as computational experience: by learning how algorithmic states evolve over iterations, a model can internalize the knowledge embodied in existing algorithms, reproduce their computational behaviors, and further evolve beyond them through training. As a first realization of this paradigm, we modelize iterative optimization as an autoregressive process, where preceding generations constitute the computational context for generating the next population. translated_title: 算法模型化：将优化算法转变为可进化的智能
translated_abstract: 算法能否像模型一样被学习和进化，而不是像程序那样被反复重新设计？我们通过引入“算法模型化”这一新范式来探索这一问题，该范式将迭代算法转化为可训练的模型。其核心思想是将算法执行轨迹视为计算经验：通过学习算法状态在迭代过程中的演化方式，模型能够内化现有算法所蕴含的知识，复现其计算行为，并通过训练进一步进化以超越现有算法。作为该范式的首次实现，我们将迭代优化建模为一个自回归过程，其中先前的世代构成了生成下一代种群的计算上下文。我们开发了一种与维度无关的种群-时间架构，以同时捕捉种群交互与迭代动力学，并提出了一种从模仿到超越的学习框架，该框架首先……
tldr: 提出“算法模型化”新范式，将迭代优化算法转化为可训练的自回归模型，通过学习算法执行轨迹使模型内化、复现并进化超越现有算法。
en_tdlr: Proposes Algorithm Modelization, a new paradigm that transforms iterative optimization algorithms into trainable autoregressive models, enabling them to internalize, reproduce, and evolve beyond existing algorithms by learning from execution trajectories.
